note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a TOG 10-14; A06b TOG 10-14; L05 TOG 23): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Togo, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually resident for at least 5 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country (decree required)
